SOC_COVER_CROPS.conditions: Global meta-analysis comparing cover-crop systems with systems without cover crops. Effects varied by cover-crop type and environmental conditions.
SOC_COVER_CROPS.time_context: Across the studies included in the meta-analysis
SOC_COVER_CROPS.source_title: Optimizing cover cropping application for sustainable crop production

SOC_ORGANIC_AMENDMENTS.conditions: Global meta-analysis of land-management practices. The reported effect varied among amendment types, soils and management conditions.
SOC_ORGANIC_AMENDMENTS.time_context: Across studies included in the meta-analysis
SOC_ORGANIC_AMENDMENTS.source_title: A global meta-analysis of soil organic carbon in the Anthropocene

BIODIVERSITY_DIVERSIFIED_FARMING.conditions: Diversified farming systems compared with simplified farming systems. Effects varied among functional groups and landscape complexity.
BIODIVERSITY_DIVERSIFIED_FARMING.time_context: Across studies included in the global meta-analysis
BIODIVERSITY_DIVERSIFIED_FARMING.source_title: Landscape complexity and functional groups moderate the effect of diversified farming on biodiversity

BIODIVERSITY_AGROFORESTRY.conditions: Temperate silvoarable agroforestry compared with monocropping; effects varied by system and management conditions.
BIODIVERSITY_AGROFORESTRY.time_context: Across the studies included in the systematic review and meta-analysis
BIODIVERSITY_AGROFORESTRY.source_title: Tree-crop combinations and their variable effects on agroecosystem services
